text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with 
Maruzensky, as we passed by a certain 
street...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh? Don't tell me this place is...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, don't you notice!? This spot 
is—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, haven't you noticed!? This 
spot is--

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The filming location for "Springtime Story 
of Eight Youths"?!

What came out of Maruzensky's mouth was 
the title of a classic masterpiece, said 
to be the originator of trendy dramas...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No way, absolutely!! It's the street 
corner from Episode 1 where Momotaro and 
Yoshimi reunite!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew, I can't believe we just happened 
to stumble upon the filming location for 
that super trendy, hit drama...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There's no other choice... we just have to 
recreate it! Let's do this, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There's no other choice... we just have to 
recreate it! Let's do this, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun will play Momotaro, and I'll 
be Yoshimi!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer-chan, you play Momotaro, and I'll 
play Yoshimi!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A few days after our terrible first 
encounter, I was walking through town when 
I bumped into someone...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Then, the two of them look at each other 
and scream! 'Ahhh! You're that person from 
before~!'

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, how trendy! Let's try it right 
away!

"...Their sparkling gazes are so dazzling. 
This place is..."
choice_data_list: Ah, what the heck, come what may!

Let's cherish the story between the two of 
you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Woo-hoo☆ As expected of my Trainer, 
totally getting into the groove!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Woo-hoo☆ As expected of my Trainer, 
totally getting into the groove!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here I go! I'll start walking 
from over there☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aah, jeez! That person the other day was 
seriously the absolute worst—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wait, eep!☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry! I'm in a huge hurry—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, waaaah~~!! You're the person from 
the other day...!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Staaare...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay, lookin' good, lookin' good! A 
flawless recreation of that iconic scene!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm suddenly getting so hyped up! Let's 
just go all out and tour all the shooting 
locations!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'll go grab Tacchan! Gimme a sec~!

Afterward, we toured filming locations 
around Tokyo until Maruzensky was 
satisfied, reenacting famous scenes along 
the way...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh... what's that mean?
choice_data_list:
This is a story just for Momotaro and 
Yoshimi.

This is a story just for Momotaro and 
Yoshimi, you know.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Ahhh~! I get it now~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"You're right, their encounter belongs to 
the two of them alone. Trying to overwrite 
it would just be a total buzzkill."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Got it! Let's hold off on that, then.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Well then, Trainer-kun, shall we 
go?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Well then, Trainer-chan, shall we 
go?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Let's search for a trendy encounter meant 
just for you and me♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Let's search for a trendy encounter meant 
just for you and me♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, stop it, Trainer-kun. Trying to 
sweet-talk me like that!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, stop it, Trainer-chan. Trying to 
sweet-talk me like that!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Being bad at mind games is cute and all, 
but big sis here is a little hurt~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"So as punishment, I'm not letting you go 
home until you find a totally 
heart-throbbing meet-cute♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm expecting great things from you!

As expected, Maruzensky was anything but 
easy to handle...
